scope: Five existing membership/invitation/expert models; read-only metadata, uniqueness, tenant relations, state constraints and last-owner trigger assertions. No new migration or claim of full R04 acceptance.

constraints.name: ExpertAssignment_assignedById_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("assignedById") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ExpertAssignment_expertUserId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("expertUserId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ExpertAssignment_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: ExpertAssignment_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((version > 0) AND ("expiresAt" > "createdAt") AND ("expertUserId" <> "assignedById") AND (((status = 'active'::text) AND ("revokedAt" IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'revoked'::text) AND ("revokedAt" IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.name: ExpertAssignment_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ExpertAssignmentService_assignment_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "assignmentId") REFERENCES "ExpertAssignment"("tenantId", id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: ExpertAssignmentService_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: ExpertAssignmentService_service_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "serviceId") REFERENCES "Service"("tenantId", id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Invitation_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: Invitation_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'accepted'::text, 'revoked'::text, 'expired'::text])))

constraints.name: Invitation_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Membership_accessKind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("accessKind" = 'direct'::text) AND ("expertAssignmentId" IS NULL)) OR (("accessKind" = 'expert'::text) AND ("expertAssignmentId" IS NOT NULL) AND (role = 'viewer'::"Role"))))

constraints.name: Membership_expertAssignment_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "expertAssignmentId", "userId") REFERENCES "ExpertAssignment"("tenantId", id, "expertUserId") ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Membership_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: Membership_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'suspended'::text, 'revoked'::text])))

constraints.name: Membership_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: Membership_userId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ServiceGrant_pkey

constraints.name: ServiceGrant_tenantId_memberId_fkey

constraints.name: ServiceGrant_tenantId_serviceId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "serviceId") REFERENCES "Service"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_last_mfa_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.role='owner' AND OLD.status='active' AND OLD."accessKind"='direct'
    AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR NEW.role<>'owner' OR NEW.status<>'active' OR NEW."tenantId"<>OLD."tenantId" OR NEW."accessKind"<>'direct') THEN
    PERFORM id FROM "Company" WHERE id=OLD."tenantId" FOR UPDATE;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "Company" c JOIN "SecurityPolicy" p ON p."tenantId"=c.id WHERE c.id=OLD."tenantId" AND c.status='active' AND p."requireMfa")
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "User" WHERE id=OLD."userId" AND "twoFactorEnabled" AND status='active')
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "Membership" m JOIN "User" u ON u.id=m."userId" WHERE m."tenantId"=OLD."tenantId" AND m.id<>OLD.id AND m.role='owner' AND m.status='active' AND m."accessKind"='direct' AND u."twoFactorEnabled" AND u.status='active' AND u."emailVerified")
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LAST_MFA_OWNER_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW;
END $function$
